translations.guide.student.beacon.toggle.text: Press the mascot to open the tutor. A dot tells you of a new answer, and a bubble of what it writes to you.
translations.guide.student.beacon.level.title: The level of the hints
translations.guide.student.beacon.level.text: Which hint you are on: each one helps you a little more than the one before, never giving you the solution.
translations.guide.student.beacon.call.title: Call the tutor
translations.guide.student.beacon.call.text: Talk to it by voice, as in a call. The audio is never recorded.
translations.guide.student.beacon.dock.title: Fixed or floating
translations.guide.student.beacon.dock.text: Leave the tutor in its column or floating over the code, as you prefer.
translations.guide.student.beacon.minimize.title: Minimise
translations.guide.student.beacon.minimize.text: Folds the tutor into the mascot. Esc folds it too.
translations.guide.student.beacon.conversation.title: The conversation
translations.guide.student.beacon.conversation.text: What you talk about with the tutor in this exercise. Sometimes it points at a line of your code or a test.
translations.guide.student.beacon.suggestions.title: Suggested questions
translations.guide.student.beacon.suggestions.text: To start talking to the tutor with a single click.
translations.guide.student.beacon.listen.title: Listen
translations.guide.student.beacon.listen.text: Reads that answer aloud to you.
translations.guide.student.beacon.hint.title: Ask for a hint
translations.guide.student.beacon.hint.text: The tutor gives you a hint to move on. If it is not enough, ask for another: each one helps a little more.
translations.guide.student.beacon.question.title: Ask the tutor
translations.guide.student.beacon.question.text: Write your question in your own words. Enter sends it; Shift + Enter, a new line.
translations.guide.student.beacon.dictate.title: Dictate
translations.guide.student.beacon.dictate.text: Say your question aloud and it writes itself. The audio is never recorded.
translations.guide.student.beacon.send.title: Send
translations.guide.student.beacon.send.text: Sends your question to the tutor.
translations.guide.student.beacon.settingsTheme.title: The theme
translations.guide.student.beacon.settingsTheme.text: Light, dark or that of your system; also from the bar.
translations.guide.student.beacon.settingsLanguage.te: That of the whole app and, when your teacher translates them, that of the exercises.
translations.guide.student.beacon.mascot.title: The mascot
translations.guide.student.beacon.mascot.text: Put on or take off its headset and its bow tie, and choose whether the pointer turns into a bone over it.
translations.guide.student.beacon.reactions.title: The reactions
translations.guide.student.beacon.reactions.text: How the tutor celebrates or cheers you on with emoji: full, reduced or off.
translations.guide.student.beacon.emojis.title: Animated emoji
translations.guide.student.beacon.emojis.text: Without them, the same emoji standing still: lighter on a slow connection.
translations.guide.student.beacon.tryReaction.title: Try a reaction
translations.guide.student.beacon.tryReaction.text: To see how what you chose looks.
translations.guide.student.beacon.proactive.title: The tutor writing on its own
translations.guide.student.beacon.proactive.text: If you have been stuck for a while, or you pass something that was hard for you, it writes to you without being asked. You can turn it off.
translations.guide.student.beacon.voice.title: Talk to the tutor by voice
translations.guide.student.beacon.voice.text: Turn it on to listen to its answers, dictate to it and call it. Once on, its choices appear.
translations.guide.student.beacon.tutorVoice.title: The voice of the tutor
translations.guide.student.beacon.tutorVoice.text: Choose among the voices of your device and listen to them first. The best ones come first.
translations.guide.student.beacon.speechRate.title: The speed
translations.guide.student.beacon.readAloud.title: Read the answers
translations.guide.student.beacon.readAloud.text: Reads each new answer aloud to you, without pressing «Listen».
translations.guide.student.beacon.interrupt.title: Interrupt by speaking
translations.guide.student.beacon.interrupt.text: In a call, if you speak while the tutor speaks, it stops. Better with headphones.
translations.guide.student.beacon.recognition.title: Where your voice is recognised
translations.guide.student.beacon.recognition.text: On this device, without the audio leaving it, or in the service of your browser. If possible, «Recognise speech on this device» downloads it.
translations.guide.student.beacon.privacy.title: Privacy
translations.guide.student.beacon.privacy.text: What is recorded while you work and who sees it.
translations.guide.student.beacon.dataRecorded.title: What is recorded
translations.guide.student.beacon.dataRecorded.text: Each piece of data saved while you work, and what for.
translations.guide.student.beacon.dataNever.title: What never is
translations.guide.student.beacon.dataNever.text: The audio of your voice is never recorded, nor what you do outside TutorIA.
translations.guide.student.beacon.dataPurpose.title: What for
translations.guide.student.beacon.dataPurpose.text: To help you learn, not to sanction.
translations.guide.student.beacon.dataViewers.title: Who sees it
translations.guide.student.beacon.dataViewers.text: Your teacher, only in their groups, and the administration. Nobody else.
translations.guide.student.beacon.dataServices.title: External services
translations.guide.student.beacon.dataServices.text: What the AI provider and the speech recognition of your browser receive.
translations.guide.student.beacon.dataChoices.title: You decide
translations.guide.student.beacon.dataChoices.text: What you can change in your settings.
translations.guide.student.tour.catalog.title: Get to know your exercises
translations.guide.student.tour.catalog.summary: Every piece of the catalogue and the bar, one by one.
translations.guide.student.tour.workspace.title: Get to know the workspace
translations.guide.student.tour.workspace.summary: The statement, the editor, the tests and the tutor, piece by piece.
translations.guide.student.tour.settings.title: Get to know your settings
translations.guide.student.tour.settings.summary: The theme, the language, the mascot, the reactions and the voice.
translations.guide.student.tour.data.title: Get to know your recorded data
translations.guide.student.tour.data.summary: What is saved, what for and who sees it.
translations.guide.student.start.title: Start an exercise
translations.guide.student.start.summary: Open an exercise and know where to write.
translations.guide.student.start.next.title: Your next exercise
translations.guide.student.start.next.text: The catalogue always suggests where to go on.
translations.guide.student.start.statement.title: The statement
translations.guide.student.start.statement.text: What your function has to do, with examples of what it receives and what it returns.
translations.guide.student.start.editor.title: Here you write
translations.guide.student.start.editor.text: Your code saves itself as you type. Whenever you like, run the tests.
translations.guide.student.run.title: Run the tests
translations.guide.student.run.summary: Check your code with the examples and the hidden tests.
translations.guide.student.run.button.title: Run the tests
translations.guide.student.run.button.text: They check your code with the examples and with other hidden tests. From the editor, also with {$keys}.
translations.guide.student.run.busy.title: They cannot run now
translations.guide.student.run.busy.text: Wait until what is under way ends, and try again.
translations.guide.student.run.results.title: The results
translations.guide.student.run.results.text: Each test says whether it passes and, if it fails, what it expected. Of the hidden ones you only learn whether you pass them.
translations.guide.student.hint.title: Ask the tutor for a hint
translations.guide.student.hint.summary: Ask for help without being given the solution.
translations.guide.student.hint.button.title: Ask for a hint
translations.guide.student.hint.button.text: The tutor helps you move on without ever giving you the solution.
translations.guide.student.hint.level.title: From less to more
translations.guide.student.hint.level.text: Each hint helps you a little more than the one before. Here you see which one you are on.
translations.guide.student.hint.question.title: Ask it
translations.guide.student.hint.question.text: You can also write your question in your own words, or ask it to explain an error.
translations.guide.student.submit.title: Submit
translations.guide.student.submit.summary: Submit an exercise once it passes every test.
translations.guide.student.submit.button.title: Submit
translations.guide.student.submit.button.text: When your code passes every test, you submit it to your teacher. It is final: afterwards it cannot change.
translations.guide.student.submit.notYet.title: You cannot submit yet
translations.guide.student.submit.notYet.text: «Submit» turns on when your code passes every test. Come back here then.
translations.guide.student.submit.confirm.title: Confirm it
translations.guide.student.submit.confirm.text: If you still want to review it, «Keep reviewing» lets you go on working.
translations.guide.student.submit.done.title: Submitted!
translations.guide.student.submit.done.text: Your teacher sees it now. If you like, you can practise it again without changing what you submitted.
translations.guide.student.language.title: Change the language
translations.guide.student.language.summary: Español, català or English, from the bar.
translations.guide.student.language.step.title: The language
translations.guide.student.language.step.text: Press here and choose yours: the app opens again in it. The exercises show in your language too when your teacher translates them.
translations.guide.student.theme.title: Change the theme: light or dark
translations.guide.student.theme.summary: From the bar, on any screen.
translations.guide.student.theme.keywords: theme dark light mode night colours appearance
translations.guide.student.theme.step.title: The theme
translations.guide.student.theme.step.text: Press here and choose light, dark or that of your system. It applies at once. It is in Settings too.
translations.guide.student.unavailable.oneSubject: When you have exercises of more than one subject
translations.guide.student.subject.title: Change subject
translations.guide.student.subject.summary: See the exercises of another subject.
translations.guide.student.subject.step.title: Your subjects
translations.guide.student.subject.step.text: Press a tab to see its topics and exercises. Your next exercise, above, is from any of them.
translations.guide.student.failing.title: See why a test fails
translations.guide.student.failing.summary: What it expected, what it returned and how to ask the tutor.
translations.guide.student.failing.keywords: error failure test result expected returns
translations.guide.student.failing.run.title: Run the tests
translations.guide.student.failing.results.title: Each test
translations.guide.student.failing.results.text: The call to your function and, if it fails, what it expected and what it returned. Of the hidden ones you only learn whether you pass them.
translations.guide.student.failing.ask.title: Ask about it
translations.guide.student.failing.ask.text: Asks the tutor about that test, so it helps you understand the failure without giving you the solution.
translations.guide.student.question.title: Ask the tutor in your own words
translations.guide.student.question.summary: Write to it, dictate to it or use a suggested question.
translations.guide.student.question.keywords: ask question doubt write chat suggestions
translations.guide.student.question.suggestions.title: Suggested questions
translations.guide.student.question.suggestions.text: To start with a click, if you do not know how to ask it.
translations.guide.student.question.field.title: Your question
translations.guide.student.question.field.text: Write your question as you would to a teacher. Enter sends it; Shift + Enter, a new line.
translations.guide.student.question.dictate.title: Or dictate it
translations.guide.student.question.dictate.text: With the voice on, say it aloud and it writes itself.
translations.guide.student.talk.title: Listen to, dictate to or call the tutor
translations.guide.student.talk.summary: Use the voice in an exercise.
translations.guide.student.talk.keywords: voice listen dictate call microphone speak
translations.guide.student.talk.listen.title: Listen
translations.guide.student.talk.listen.text: On each answer: the tutor reads it aloud to you.
translations.guide.student.talk.dictate.title: Dictate
translations.guide.student.talk.dictate.text: Say your question and it writes itself.
translations.guide.student.talk.call.title: Call the tutor
translations.guide.student.talk.call.text: Talk to it as in a call.
translations.guide.student.talk.end.title: The audio is never recorded
translations.guide.student.talk.end.text: If you do not see these buttons, turn on «Talk to the tutor by voice» in Settings.
translations.guide.student.voice.title: Set up the voice of the tutor
translations.guide.student.voice.summary: Turn it on, choose its voice and its speed, and where yours is recognised.
translations.guide.student.voice.keywords: voice speak listen dictate call microphone speed local device
translations.guide.student.voice.toggle.title: Talk to the tutor by voice
translations.guide.student.voice.toggle.text: To listen to its answers, dictate to it and call it. Turn it on and I show you its choices; you can turn it off whenever you like.
translations.guide.student.voice.choice.title: The voice of the tutor
translations.guide.student.voice.choice.text: Choose among the voices of your device; listen to them before keeping one.
translations.guide.student.voice.rate.title: The speed
translations.guide.student.voice.readAloud.title: Read the answers
translations.guide.student.voice.readAloud.text: Reads each new answer aloud to you, without pressing «Listen».
translations.guide.student.voice.interrupt.title: Interrupt by speaking
translations.guide.student.voice.interrupt.text: In a call, if you speak while the tutor speaks, it stops. Better with headphones.
translations.guide.student.voice.recognition.title: Where your voice is recognised
translations.guide.student.voice.recognition.text: On this device, without the audio leaving it, or in the service of your browser. If possible, «Recognise speech on this device» downloads it.
translations.guide.student.voice.where.title: In each exercise
translations.guide.student.voice.where.text: With the voice on, beside the tutor you have «Listen», «Dictate» and «Call the tutor». The audio is never recorded.
translations.guide.student.reactions.title: Change the reactions of the tutor
translations.guide.student.reactions.summary: More, fewer or no emoji in its answers.
translations.guide.student.reactions.choice.title: The reactions
translations.guide.student.reactions.emojis.title: Animated emoji
translations.guide.student.reactions.emojis.text: Without them, the same emoji standing still, lighter.
translations.guide.student.reactions.try.title: Try it
translations.guide.student.mascot.title: Dress the mascot
translations.guide.student.mascot.summary: The headset, the bow tie and the bone pointer.
translations.guide.student.mascot.keywords: mascot dog headset bow tie bone
translations.guide.student.mascot.step.title: The mascot
translations.guide.student.mascot.step.text: Put on or take off its headset and its bow tie, and choose whether the pointer turns into a bone over it.
translations.guide.student.proactive.title: The tutor writing on its own, or not
translations.guide.student.proactive.summary: When you have been stuck for a while or pass something hard.
translations.guide.student.proactive.keywords: proactive notices messages bother writes alone
translations.guide.student.proactive.step.title: The tutor writes to you
translations.guide.student.proactive.step.text: If you have been stuck for a while, or you pass something that was hard for you, it writes to you without being asked. Turn it off if you prefer it only to answer.
translations.guide.student.arrange.title: Arrange the workspace
translations.guide.student.arrange.summary: More room for the code, the statement or the tutor.
translations.guide.student.arrange.keywords: size expand fold move tutor floating screen
translations.guide.student.arrange.intro.title: Your way
translations.guide.student.arrange.intro.text: Share the screen as suits you best; it is remembered for next time.
translations.guide.student.format.title: Tidy your code
translations.guide.student.format.summary: The indentation and the spaces, in one click.
translations.guide.student.unavailable.noSubmitted: When you have submitted an exercise
translations.guide.student.practise.title: Practise a submitted exercise again
translations.guide.student.practise.summary: Repeat it without changing what your teacher sees.
translations.guide.student.practise.button.title: Practise again
translations.guide.student.practise.button.text: You start a new attempt to practise. What you submitted does not change.
translations.guide.student.practise.note.title: You are practising
translations.guide.student.practise.note.text: This attempt does not count for the class: your teacher still sees your first submission.
translations.guide.student.unavailable.noAttempts: When you have practised an exercise again
translations.guide.student.attempts.title: Go back to an earlier attempt
translations.guide.student.attempts.summary: Read again what you submitted before practising.
translations.guide.student.attempts.menu.title: Your attempts
translations.guide.student.attempts.menu.text: Each time you practise an exercise again, you start an attempt. Here you have them all.
translations.guide.student.attempts.choice.title: Choose one
translations.guide.student.attempts.choice.text: The earlier ones are read only; in the last one you can go on working.
translations.guide.student.nextExercise.title: Go on to the next exercise
translations.guide.student.nextExercise.summary: Go on with the topic without going back to the catalogue.
translations.guide.student.data.title: See what data is recorded
translations.guide.student.data.summary: Know what is saved, what for and who sees it.
translations.guide.student.data.menu.title: Your menu
translations.guide.student.data.menu.text: Here you have your settings, your data and the way out.
translations.guide.student.data.link.title: Recorded data
translations.guide.student.data.link.text: It tells you what is saved while you work, what for and who sees it.
translations.guide.student.data.recorded.title: What is recorded
translations.guide.student.data.recorded.text: Your code, the tests, the hints and the conversation with the tutor, among other things.
translations.guide.student.data.never.title: What never is
translations.guide.student.data.never.text: The audio of your voice is never recorded.
translations.guide.student.data.viewers.title: Who sees it
translations.guide.student.data.viewers.text: Your teacher, only in their groups, and the administration. Nobody else.
translations.guide.student.signOut.title: Sign out
translations.guide.student.signOut.summary: Leave, above all on a shared computer.
translations.guide.student.signOut.keywords: leave sign out log out disconnect account
translations.guide.student.signOut.menu.title: Your menu
translations.guide.student.signOut.menu.text: At the top right, on any screen.
translations.guide.student.signOut.item.title: Sign out
translations.guide.student.signOut.item.text: Press it when you finish. Your code is saved already.
translations.guide.student.welcome.hello.title: Hello, {$name}!
translations.guide.student.welcome.hello.text: I am the tutor of TutorIA. I show you in a moment where each thing is; you can skip it whenever you like.
translations.guide.student.welcome.help.title: The help
translations.guide.student.welcome.help.text: You always have it here: the first steps, how to do each thing and the tour of each screen, piece by piece.
translations.guide.student.welcome.theme.title: Light or dark
translations.guide.student.welcome.theme.text: The theme: light, dark or that of your system. Try it now if you like.
translations.guide.student.welcome.language.title: Your language
translations.guide.student.welcome.language.text: Español, català or English. If you prefer another, choose it now and we go on in it.
translations.guide.student.welcome.menu.title: Your menu
translations.guide.student.welcome.menu.text: Your settings (the mascot, the reactions, the voice of the tutor), your recorded data and «Sign out».
translations.guide.student.welcome.subjects.title: Your subjects
translations.guide.student.welcome.subjects.text: Each one has its exercises, ordered by topics.
translations.guide.student.welcome.next.title: Where to go on
translations.guide.student.welcome.next.text: Here you always have your next exercise, or the one you left halfway.
translations.guide.teacher.beacon.menuButton.title: The menu
translations.guide.teacher.beacon.menuButton.text: Folds the menu to its icons to leave more room, or unfolds it. On phones, it opens it.
translations.guide.teacher.beacon.brand.title: TutorIA
translations.guide.teacher.beacon.brand.text: From any screen, takes you to the live session.
translations.guide.teacher.beacon.help.title: Help
translations.guide.teacher.beacon.help.text: Your first steps, the tour of each screen, the help of each piece and the welcome.
translations.guide.teacher.beacon.theme.title: Theme
translations.guide.teacher.beacon.language.title: Language
translations.guide.teacher.beacon.language.text: Español, català or English. Exercises show in the languages they are translated into.
translations.guide.teacher.beacon.userMenu.title: Your menu
translations.guide.teacher.beacon.userMenu.text: The account you signed in with, and «Sign out».
translations.guide.teacher.beacon.navLive.title: Live
translations.guide.teacher.beacon.navLive.text: How your group is doing right now, exercise by exercise, and who needs help.
translations.guide.teacher.beacon.navHistory.title: History
translations.guide.teacher.beacon.navHistory.text: How each group evolves, block by block, also in past years.
translations.guide.teacher.beacon.navBank.title: Exercises
translations.guide.teacher.beacon.navBank.text: The shared bank of all teachers: search, duplicate or write exercises with their tests.
translations.guide.teacher.beacon.navBlocks.title: Blocks
translations.guide.teacher.beacon.navBlocks.text: The units of each group and the exercises you assign them, in the order they will see them.
translations.guide.teacher.beacon.navGroups.title: Groups
translations.guide.teacher.beacon.navGroups.text: Your classes, their subjects and their students: this is where they are created and students enrolled.
translations.guide.teacher.beacon.liveState.title: Live or out of class
translations.guide.teacher.beacon.liveState.text: Live while someone in the group is working now; otherwise, when the last activity was.
translations.guide.teacher.beacon.liveGroup.title: The group
translations.guide.teacher.beacon.liveGroup.text: Each subject of each class you teach is a group. Choose the one you want to follow.
translations.guide.teacher.beacon.liveBlock.title: The block
translations.guide.teacher.beacon.liveBlock.text: The unit you follow. A green dot marks those with activity now.
translations.guide.teacher.beacon.liveRhythm.title: Pace of the class
translations.guide.teacher.beacon.liveRhythm.text: How much activity there is minute by minute: if it drops suddenly, maybe everyone is stuck.
translations.guide.teacher.beacon.liveQueue.title: Need attention
translations.guide.teacher.beacon.liveQueue.text: Who has been stuck for a while or has asked for many hints, the longest waiting first. «Attended» takes them off the list.
translations.guide.teacher.beacon.liveClass.title: Where the class is
translations.guide.teacher.beacon.liveClass.text: How many are on each exercise and how: in progress, failing, passed or submitted. Press a bar to see who they are.
translations.guide.teacher.beacon.liveTabs.title: The students
translations.guide.teacher.beacon.liveTabs.text: All of them, those who have started or those who have finished, with how many there are in each tab.
translations.guide.teacher.beacon.liveSearch.title: Search student
translations.guide.teacher.beacon.liveSearch.text: By name, without worrying about accents.
translations.guide.teacher.beacon.liveTable.title: Each student
translations.guide.teacher.beacon.liveTable.text: Their status, how many tests they pass, the hints they asked for and their last activity. Press their name to see the detail.
translations.guide.teacher.beacon.detailBack.title: Back
translations.guide.teacher.beacon.detailBack.text: To the live session, with the same group and the same block.
translations.guide.teacher.beacon.detailHeader.title: The student and their exercise
translations.guide.teacher.beacon.detailHeader.text: How they are doing, which exercise and block they are on and, if they repeat it, which attempt it is.
translations.guide.teacher.beacon.detailAttempts.text: If they have practised the exercise more than once, each attempt on its own.
translations.guide.teacher.beacon.detailAttend.title: Attended
translations.guide.teacher.beacon.detailAttend.text: Why they need help. Once you have helped them, mark it and they leave the attention list.
translations.guide.teacher.beacon.detailNow.title: Now
translations.guide.teacher.beacon.detailNow.text: The tests they fail, the last help from the tutor and the summary: working time, runs, hints and whether they pasted code or left the window.
translations.guide.teacher.beacon.detailEvolution.tex: The tests they passed on each run and when they asked for hints. Press a point to go to that moment.
translations.guide.teacher.beacon.detailTimeline.text: Everything they did, in order: when they opened the exercise, each run, each hint and what the tutor answered.
translations.guide.teacher.beacon.detailTimelineFilte: Everything, only the tests or only the tutor.
translations.guide.teacher.beacon.detailCode.title: Their code
translations.guide.teacher.beacon.detailCode.text: The one they submitted or, if they are still working, the current one. Read only: it cannot be changed.
translations.guide.teacher.beacon.bankNew.title: New exercise
translations.guide.teacher.beacon.bankNew.text: Write one with its statement and its tests. All the teachers of its subjects will see it.
translations.guide.teacher.beacon.bankSearch.title: Search
translations.guide.teacher.beacon.bankSearch.text: By title, content or function name.
translations.guide.teacher.beacon.bankSubject.title: Subject
translations.guide.teacher.beacon.bankSubject.text: It starts with yours; choose another or «All» to see the rest of the bank.
translations.guide.teacher.beacon.bankMine.title: Only mine
translations.guide.teacher.beacon.bankMine.text: Those you wrote: the only ones you can change. To adapt somebody else’s, duplicate it.
translations.guide.teacher.beacon.bankArchived.title: Archived
translations.guide.teacher.beacon.bankArchived.text: Those no longer used: they leave the bank without anybody losing their attempts.
translations.guide.teacher.beacon.bankCount.title: How many there are
translations.guide.teacher.beacon.bankCount.text: Those that match the filters, out of all those of the chosen subjects.
translations.guide.teacher.beacon.bankExercise.title: Each exercise
translations.guide.teacher.beacon.bankExercise.text: Its difficulty, its subjects and its function; if it is yours, how many tests it has, where it is assigned and how many students have started it.
translations.guide.teacher.beacon.bankActions.title: Its actions
translations.guide.teacher.beacon.bankActions.text: Edit or view it, duplicate it, assign it to a block and, if it is yours, archive it.
translations.guide.teacher.beacon.formBack.title: Back
translations.guide.teacher.beacon.formBack.text: To the bank. If there are unsaved changes, it asks you first.
translations.guide.teacher.beacon.formTryout.title: Try as a student
translations.guide.teacher.beacon.formTryout.text: The students’ workspace, with the tutor, with the exercise as it is. It needs the function and one test.
translations.guide.teacher.beacon.formStatement.title: Title and statement
translations.guide.teacher.beacon.formStatement.text: In the language you write it in; once you save it, you can translate it with AI into the other two.
The subjects decide who sees it in the bank.
translations.guide.teacher.beacon.formThresholds.text: How many failures in a row or minutes without activity wait before the tutor offers itself.
translations.guide.teacher.beacon.formFunction.title: The function
translations.guide.teacher.beacon.formFunction.text: Its name and its parameters, in English. With them, the tutor gives the student the skeleton to start with.
translations.guide.teacher.beacon.formTests.title: Automatic tests
translations.guide.teacher.beacon.formTests.text: The arguments and the expected result, in JSON. The visible ones are the examples of the statement; the hidden ones, the edge cases.
translations.guide.teacher.beacon.formCheck.title: Try my solution
translations.guide.teacher.beacon.formCheck.text: Write a solution and check that the tests are right. It is not saved.
translations.guide.teacher.beacon.formSave.title: Save
translations.guide.teacher.beacon.formSave.text: If something is missing, it tells you what. «Cancel» goes back to the bank without saving.
translations.guide.teacher.beacon.blocksGroup.title: Year and group
translations.guide.teacher.beacon.blocksGroup.text: Blocks belong to each group: to one subject in one class.
translations.guide.teacher.beacon.blocksClosed.title: A closed year
translations.guide.teacher.beacon.blocksClosed.text: Its blocks can be seen and copied into a group of this year, but not changed.
translations.guide.teacher.beacon.blocksCopy.title: Copy from another group
translations.guide.teacher.beacon.blocksCopy.text: Brings the blocks of another group of yours, also of a past year, with their exercises.
translations.guide.teacher.beacon.blocksSelect.title: Select
translations.guide.teacher.beacon.blocksSelect.text: To delete several blocks at once. Those somebody has started are not deleted: hide them.
translations.guide.teacher.beacon.blocksNew.title: New block
translations.guide.teacher.beacon.blocksNew.text: A unit, a review or a resit, with the date it opens if you like.
translations.guide.teacher.beacon.blocksList.title: The blocks of the group
translations.guide.teacher.beacon.blocksList.text: In the order your students will see them.
translations.guide.teacher.beacon.blocksDrag.title: Reorder
translations.guide.teacher.beacon.blocksDrag.text: Drag a block or an exercise to its place, or use «Move up» and «Move down» in its menu.
translations.guide.teacher.beacon.blocksVisible.title: Visible
translations.guide.teacher.beacon.blocksVisible.text: Off, your students do not see the block until you turn it on.
translations.guide.teacher.beacon.blocksMenu.title: The menu of the block
translations.guide.teacher.beacon.blocksMenu.text: Edit it, add exercises to it, set a due date for the whole block, move it or delete it.
translations.guide.teacher.beacon.blocksExercise.text: Its number in the block, its difficulty and how many students have started it.
translations.guide.teacher.beacon.blocksDue.title: Due date
translations.guide.teacher.beacon.blocksDue.text: The one of this exercise, which your students see in their list. «Due date for the whole block», in the menu of the block.
translations.guide.teacher.beacon.blocksHide.title: Hide
translations.guide.teacher.beacon.blocksHide.text: Hides the exercise from your students without removing it from the block.
Move it up or down, move it to another block or remove it. If somebody has started it, better hide it.
translations.guide.teacher.beacon.blocksAdd.title: Add exercises
translations.guide.teacher.beacon.blocksAdd.text: Choose exercises from the bank and they are added at the end of the block.
translations.guide.teacher.beacon.groupsYear.title: Year
translations.guide.teacher.beacon.groupsYear.text: This year or a past one, which can be seen but not changed.
translations.guide.teacher.beacon.groupsClass.title: The class
translations.guide.teacher.beacon.groupsClass.text: Such as 1.º DAW A: all its teachers share it, each with their subjects.
translations.guide.teacher.beacon.groupsClassMenu.tex: Edit it, duplicate it for next year or delete it while it has no subjects.
translations.guide.teacher.beacon.groupsAddClass.text: A new one, or another teacher’s if it already exists: type its name and it tells you.
translations.guide.teacher.beacon.groupsRoster.title: The students
translations.guide.teacher.beacon.groupsRoster.text: Who is in the class and in which subjects.
translations.guide.teacher.beacon.groupsFilter.title: Filter students
translations.guide.teacher.beacon.groupsOutcomes.text: At the end of the year, who moves up, repeats, graduates or leaves their studies.
translations.guide.teacher.beacon.groupsEnroll.title: Enroll in the class
translations.guide.teacher.beacon.groupsEnroll.text: With a list of emails, from another class or searching for them. They join all its subjects, except the splits.
translations.guide.teacher.beacon.groupsAddSubject.te: Those you teach in this class; each one is a group, with its splits if there are any.
translations.guide.teacher.beacon.groupsExport.title: Export
translations.guide.teacher.beacon.groupsExport.text: The list as CSV or the emails copied, to paste them wherever you like.
translations.guide.teacher.beacon.groupsTable.title: The table
translations.guide.teacher.beacon.groupsTable.text: A row per student and a column per subject, with its teacher and how many students it has.
translations.guide.teacher.beacon.groupsSubjectMenu.t: Edit it, see its blocks, enroll only in it or delete it if nobody has worked in it.
translations.guide.teacher.beacon.groupsStudentMenu.t: Remove them from the class and all its subjects. Their work is kept.
translations.guide.teacher.beacon.historyGroup.title: Year and group
translations.guide.teacher.beacon.historyGroup.text: Also of past years, to compare.
translations.guide.teacher.beacon.historyEvolution.te: How many hints each student asks for on average in each block: if they go down, the group gains autonomy.
translations.guide.teacher.beacon.historyBlock.title: Each block
translations.guide.teacher.beacon.historyBlock.text: How many passed each exercise, how long they took, where they got stuck and what arrived on time for each due date.
translations.guide.teacher.tour.live.title: Get to know the live session
translations.guide.teacher.tour.live.summary: Each piece of the live session, the bar and the menu.
translations.guide.teacher.tour.attempt.title: Get to know the detail of an attempt
translations.guide.teacher.tour.attempt.summary: What a student did in an exercise, step by step.
translations.guide.teacher.tour.attempt.unavailable: Open the detail of a student from Live
translations.guide.teacher.tour.bank.title: Get to know the bank of exercises
translations.guide.teacher.tour.bank.summary: Searching, filtering and the actions of each exercise.
translations.guide.teacher.tour.form.title: Get to know the form of an exercise
translations.guide.teacher.tour.form.summary: The statement, the function, the tests and how to check them.
translations.guide.teacher.tour.blocks.title: Get to know the blocks
translations.guide.teacher.tour.blocks.summary: The units of a group and their exercises, piece by piece.
translations.guide.teacher.tour.groups.title: Get to know the groups
translations.guide.teacher.tour.groups.summary: Your classes, their subjects and their students.
translations.guide.teacher.tour.history.title: Get to know the history
translations.guide.teacher.tour.history.summary: How a group evolves, block by block.
translations.guide.teacher.welcome.hello.title: Hello, {$name}!
translations.guide.teacher.welcome.hello.text: I am the tutor of TutorIA. I show you in a moment where each thing is; you can skip it whenever you like.
translations.guide.teacher.welcome.help.title: Help
translations.guide.teacher.welcome.help.text: Always here: your first steps, the tour of each screen and the explanation of each piece.
translations.guide.teacher.welcome.theme.title: Light or dark
translations.guide.teacher.welcome.theme.text: The theme: light, dark or your system’s. Try it now if you like.
translations.guide.teacher.welcome.language.title: Your language
translations.guide.teacher.welcome.language.text: Español, català or English. If you prefer another, choose it now and we go on in it.
translations.guide.teacher.welcome.menu.title: Your menu
translations.guide.teacher.welcome.menu.text: The account you signed in with, and «Sign out».
translations.guide.teacher.welcome.sideMenu.title: Your screens
translations.guide.teacher.welcome.sideMenu.text: Everything you do is in this menu. The button at the top left folds it to its icons or, on phones, opens it.
translations.guide.teacher.welcome.live.title: Live
translations.guide.teacher.welcome.live.text: How your group is doing while it works, exercise by exercise, and who needs help.
translations.guide.teacher.welcome.bank.title: Exercises
translations.guide.teacher.welcome.bank.text: The shared bank of the teachers, with its automatic tests.
translations.guide.teacher.welcome.groups.title: Groups
translations.guide.teacher.welcome.groups.text: Your classes, their subjects and their students. You will see Blocks and History in their help.
translations.guide.teacher.welcome.next.title: Where to go on
translations.guide.teacher.welcome.next.text: Your first steps take you through preparing your first class from start to finish. They are always in «Help».
translations.guide.teacher.unavailable.noClass: Once you have a class with a subject of yours
translations.guide.teacher.unavailable.noBlock: Once you have created a block
translations.guide.teacher.unavailable.noAssignment: Once you have assigned an exercise to a block
translations.guide.teacher.createClass.title: Create your class and enroll its students
translations.guide.teacher.createClass.summary: Your class, the subjects you teach in it and its students.
translations.guide.teacher.createClass.keywords: group class subject enroll students year join
translations.guide.teacher.createClass.nav.title: Groups
translations.guide.teacher.createClass.nav.text: Your classes, their subjects and their students are in Groups.
translations.guide.teacher.createClass.add.title: Add class
translations.guide.teacher.createClass.add.text: You are going to create a real class. If it was only to try, afterwards remove its subjects and delete it from its «⋮» menu.
translations.guide.teacher.createClass.dialog.title: The class
translations.guide.teacher.createClass.dialog.text: Its name, such as 1.º DAW A, and its year. If it already exists because another teacher teaches it, it tells you as you type: join it with your subjects.
translations.guide.teacher.createClass.dialog.action: Type its name and press «Create and choose subjects»
translations.guide.teacher.createClass.subjects.title: Your subjects
translations.guide.teacher.createClass.subjects.text: Tick those you teach in this class. Each one is a group, with its own students and blocks.
translations.guide.teacher.createClass.enroll.title: Enroll in the class
translations.guide.teacher.createClass.enroll.text: The students join the class and all its subjects, except the splits.
translations.guide.teacher.createClass.enrollDialog.t: Choose them among those without a class this year, paste their emails, bring them from another class or search for them. Only existing accounts are there: if someone is missing, ask the administration to sign them up.
translations.guide.teacher.createClass.table.title: Your students
translations.guide.teacher.createClass.table.text: A row per student and a column per subject. From the menu of each one, you remove them from the class.
translations.guide.teacher.createBlock.title: Create a block
translations.guide.teacher.createBlock.summary: A unit of a group, which you then fill with exercises.
translations.guide.teacher.createBlock.nav.title: Blocks
translations.guide.teacher.createBlock.nav.text: The units of each group are in Blocks.
translations.guide.teacher.createBlock.group.title: The group
translations.guide.teacher.createBlock.group.text: Each subject of a class has its blocks. Choose here the one of the new block.
translations.guide.teacher.createBlock.new.title: New block
translations.guide.teacher.createBlock.new.text: It is really created. If it was only to try, delete it from its «⋮» menu while nobody has started it.
translations.guide.teacher.createBlock.dialog.title: The block
translations.guide.teacher.createBlock.dialog.text: Its title, such as «Unit 1: Loops». You can leave it hidden or have it open on a given day.
translations.guide.teacher.createBlock.dialog.action: Type its title and press «Create the block»
translations.guide.teacher.createBlock.list.title: Your blocks
translations.guide.teacher.createBlock.list.text: In the order your students will see them. With «Visible» you decide whether they see it, and from its menu you add exercises to it.
translations.guide.teacher.addExercise.title: Add an exercise to the bank
translations.guide.teacher.addExercise.summary: Write an exercise with its statement and its tests.
translations.guide.teacher.addExercise.keywords: new exercise create write tests statement function
translations.guide.teacher.addExercise.nav.title: Exercises
translations.guide.teacher.addExercise.nav.text: The shared bank of all teachers is in Exercises.
translations.guide.teacher.addExercise.new.title: New exercise
translations.guide.teacher.addExercise.new.text: Before writing one, search: maybe another teacher already has it and duplicating it is enough.
translations.guide.teacher.addExercise.statement.text: What the function has to do, with examples. Write code between backticks.
translations.guide.teacher.addExercise.classification: The subjects decide who sees it in the bank.
translations.guide.teacher.addExercise.function.title: The function
translations.guide.teacher.addExercise.function.text: Its name and its parameters, in English, as real code.
translations.guide.teacher.addExercise.tests.title: The tests
translations.guide.teacher.addExercise.tests.text: What it receives and what it must return. Leave the examples of the statement visible and hide the edge cases.
translations.guide.teacher.addExercise.check.title: Try my solution
translations.guide.teacher.addExercise.check.text: Write a solution and check that your tests are right before giving it to your students.
translations.guide.teacher.addExercise.save.title: Create the exercise
translations.guide.teacher.addExercise.save.text: When everything is there, press «Create the exercise»: if something is missing, it tells you what. It is saved in the shared bank; if you do not want it, archive or delete it from its menu while nobody has started it.
translations.guide.teacher.assign.title: Assign an exercise to a block
translations.guide.teacher.assign.summary: Take exercises from the bank to a block of your group.
translations.guide.teacher.assign.list.title: Your blocks
translations.guide.teacher.assign.list.text: Exercises are assigned to a block, and your students see them in that order.
translations.guide.teacher.assign.add.title: Add exercises
translations.guide.teacher.assign.add.text: Each block has its own, at the end.
translations.guide.teacher.assign.dialog.title: Choose from the bank
translations.guide.teacher.assign.dialog.text: Search and tick those you want: they are added at the end of the block. If there is none of your subject, write one first in Exercises.
translations.guide.teacher.assign.exercise.title: They are assigned
translations.guide.teacher.assign.exercise.text: Each with its due date, the eye to hide it and its menu. If nobody has started it, «Remove» takes it out of the block.
translations.guide.teacher.followLive.title: Follow the class live
translations.guide.teacher.followLive.summary: See how your group is doing and who needs help.
translations.guide.teacher.followLive.keywords: live class follow stuck help detail
translations.guide.teacher.followLive.nav.title: Live
translations.guide.teacher.followLive.nav.text: What your group is doing right now is in Live.
translations.guide.teacher.followLive.group.title: Group and block
translations.guide.teacher.followLive.group.text: Choose the group and, beside it, the block it works on today.
translations.guide.teacher.followLive.state.title: Live?
translations.guide.teacher.followLive.state.text: Live while someone is working; out of class, what they left done.
translations.guide.teacher.followLive.rhythm.title: Pace of the class
translations.guide.teacher.followLive.rhythm.text: How much activity there is minute by minute.
translations.guide.teacher.followLive.queue.title: Who needs help
translations.guide.teacher.followLive.queue.text: Who has been stuck for a while or has asked for many hints. Once you help them, mark them as attended.
translations.guide.teacher.followLive.class.title: Where the class is
translations.guide.teacher.followLive.class.text: How many are on each exercise and how. Press a bar to see who they are.
translations.guide.teacher.followLive.tabs.title: The students
translations.guide.teacher.followLive.tabs.text: All of them, those who have started or those who have finished.
translations.guide.teacher.followLive.table.title: The detail of each one
translations.guide.teacher.followLive.table.text: Press the name of a student to see their code, their tests and what the tutor told them.
